@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+name: Build GhosttyKit
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: macos-15
+    timeout-minutes: 60
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Install Zig
+        uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2
+        with:
+          version: 0.15.2
+
+      - name: Build xcframework
+        run: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Demit-xcframework=true -Dxcframework-target=universal -Demit-macos-app=false
+
+      - name: Compress xcframework
+        run: |
+          cd macos
+          tar czf GhosttyKit.xcframework.tar.gz GhosttyKit.xcframework/
+
+      - name: Create release
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          BUILD_DATE: ${{ github.run_id }}
+        run: |
+          TAG="build-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
+          COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
+
+          if gh release view "$TAG" &> /dev/null; then
+            gh release delete "$TAG" --yes
+            git push --delete origin "$TAG" 2>/dev/null || true
+          fi
+
+          gh release create "$TAG" \
+            --title "GhosttyKit $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
+            --latest \
+            --notes "Built from commit ${COMMIT} on $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
+            macos/GhosttyKit.xcframework.tar.gz

@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+name: Sync Upstream
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  sync:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+      pull-requests: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          token: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Configure git identity
+        run: |
+          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
+          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+
+      - name: Fetch upstream
+        run: |
+          git remote add upstream https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty.git
+          git fetch upstream main
+
+      - name: Check if sync needed
+        id: check
+        run: |
+          BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..upstream/main)
+          echo "behind=$BEHIND" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          if [ "$BEHIND" = "0" ]; then
+            echo "main is already up to date with upstream"
+          else
+            echo "main is $BEHIND commit(s) behind upstream"
+          fi
+
+      - name: Create sync branch and merge
+        if: steps.check.outputs.behind != '0'
+        id: merge
+        run: |
+          DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
+          BRANCH="sync/upstream-$DATE"
+          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
+          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+          if git merge upstream/main --no-edit; then
+            echo "conflicts=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo "conflicts=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            git merge --abort
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Push sync branch
+        if: steps.check.outputs.behind != '0' && steps.merge.outputs.conflicts == 'false'
+        run: |
+          git push --set-upstream origin "${{ steps.merge.outputs.branch }}"
+
+      - name: Open pull request
+        if: steps.check.outputs.behind != '0' && steps.merge.outputs.conflicts == 'false'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          gh pr create \
+            --base main \
+            --head "${{ steps.merge.outputs.branch }}" \
+            --title "Sync upstream ($(date -u +%Y-%m-%d))" \
+            --body "Automated merge of \`ghostty-org/ghostty@main\` into \`main\`. Review the diff and merge if our customizations still compile and behave correctly. Trigger the Build GhosttyKit workflow on main after merging to refresh the xcframework."
